observed_issue: After toggling a device time slot, its text and dependent values updated but the button color did not follow the new on/off state.
root_cause: The San template derived the class through slotClass(device.id, hour), while schedule was read only inside that ordinary method. San therefore did not register schedule as a template-expression dependency and could retain the previous class after schedule changed.
fix: The template now calls slotClass(device.id, hour, schedule), and slotClass derives the class from the explicitly supplied schedule argument. This makes schedule a reactive dependency without changing the frozen formal_30_v1 artifact.
manual_checks: Initial device schedule, selected hour, load chart, load details, peak load, and estimated cost match Vue.
Selecting an hour updates its active style and the detail panel.
Toggling a device time slot updates its on/off text and color, selected hour, chart, load values, peak, cost, and limit warning.
Balancing the peak updates the schedule, optimized state, chart, load values, peak, cost, and warning consistently.
Editing the scenario name and saving creates a scenario entry with the current cost and peak.
